description: When you are about to quote a stored excerpt from a search or find_* cite: call get_passage with uri, id, or source plus doc. Returns the stored passage. Cost 1 query. Not a live web fetch. If ok is false, the index has no passage.

doc.description: Document id when id is omitted (with source).

id.description: Vectorize id from a search cite.

source.description: Corpus source when id is omitted (with doc).

uri.description: intel:// locator from a cite. Preferred over id when present.

name: get_passage
